Shared/Ics/IcsBuilder.cs — static helper `public static string Build(MeetingResult meeting, IReadOnlyList<AttendeeDto> attendees, string organizerEmail, string? description = null)`. RFC 5545 minimal VCALENDAR: PRODID Invekto, VERSION 2.0, METHOD REQUEST, VTIMEZONE per unique TZID in attendees (IANA TZ database lookup via TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById — Windows/Linux both supported via System.TimeZoneConverter package if needed — but AC keeps to TimeZoneInfo default), VEVENT per meeting with DTSTART;TZID=<dentistTZ> + DTEND computed + ORGANIZER mailto:+ UID meeting.CalendarEventId-or-hash + ATTENDEE mailto per attendee-with-email (phone-only attendees NOT in ATTENDEE — they get WA template separately per Chunk B). LF line endings + CRLF per RFC 5545. Unit test: Build() output contains 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR', 'VERSION:2.0', 'VTIMEZONE' for each distinct TZ, 'DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Istanbul:20260501T100000', 'ATTENDEE;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:' only for email-attendees, closing 'END:VCALENDAR'. No network call, no I/O, pure function.

Invekto.Integrations/Services/Video/GoogleMeetMockProvider.cs — implements IVideoConsultProvider. CreateMeetingAsync implementation: (1) input validation (DurationMinutes > 0, Attendees.Count >= 1, StartAtUtc > DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1) [allow slight clock skew], DentistTimeZoneId non-empty) — any fail → ArgumentException propagate (Chunk B caller wraps in MeetingResult failure response when wired); (2) deterministic hash = SHA256(tenantId + '|' + title.Trim() + '|' + startAtUtc.ToString('O')).ToBase64Url() first 10 chars; (3) link = $"https://meet.google.com/mock-{hash}" — Q OVERRIDE per interview question 4 (spec'teki ornek sect; 'mock' prefix Google subdomain convention'a uymuyor bu nedenle 404 beklenir, sinyal net); (4) return new MeetingResult {MeetingLink=link, CalendarEventId=null (mock), Provider='mock', StartAtUtc=req.StartAtUtc, DurationMinutes=req.DurationMinutes}. NO network call, NO DB write. Pure. Singleton DI. XML doc calls out: 'Deterministic hash = same inputs produce same link — tests can assert stability; production callers should pass unique titles/times to avoid collision.'

Invekto.Integrations/Services/Video/VideoProviderFactory.cs — single-responsibility factory. `public virtual async Task<IVideoConsultProvider?> ResolveAsync(int tenantId, CancellationToken ct)`: (1) settings = await _tenantSettingsRepo.FindByTenantIdAsync(tenantId, ct); (2) provider_name = settings?.VideoProvider ?? null; (3) switch provider_name: 'mock' → return _mockProvider (DI-injected GoogleMeetMockProvider); 'googlemeet' → return null (Chunk C will register GoogleMeetProvider, Chunk A fallback null + caller emits INV-INT-142); null → return null (tenant not configured). Try/catch NpgsqlException → _logger.SystemWarn INV-INT-142 msg 'tenant_settings read failed' + return null (graceful — caller sees provider_not_configured same as genuine miss). Singleton DI (stateless). XML doc: 'Chunk A only wires mock; Chunk C will register googlemeet. Caller gets null for unconfigured/googlemeet until Chunk C ships.'
